title: Add Accordion
content: Create accordion component with collapsible sections. Container: divide-y divide-gray-200 rounded-lg border. Item: border-b last:border-b-0. Header button: w-full flex justify-between items-center p-4 text-left hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors. Title: font-medium text-gray-900. Icon: ChevronDown rotating 180deg when open (rotate-180 transition-transform). Content panel: overflow-hidden, animate height from 0 to auto. Content padding: p-4 pt-0. Allow single or multiple open panels. Use data-state="open"/"closed" for styling. Smooth height animation using grid-rows trick or max-height.

variants.simple: Create expandable accordion sections with smooth animations.
variants.detailed: Create accordion component with collapsible sections. Container: divide-y divide-gray-200 rounded-lg border. Item: border-b last:border-b-0. Header button: w-full flex justify-between items-center p-4 text-left hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors. Title: font-medium text-gray-900. Icon: ChevronDown rotating 180deg when open (rotate-180 transition-transform). Content panel: overflow-hidden, animate height from 0 to auto. Content padding: p-4 pt-0. Allow single or multiple open panels. Use data-state="open"/"closed" for styling. Smooth height animation using grid-rows trick or max-height.
variants.advanced: Create fully accessible accordion component following WAI-ARIA pattern. Structure: div container, each item has button header and div panel. Header button: id, aria-expanded, aria-controls pointing to panel id. Panel: id, aria-labelledby pointing to header, role="region". Styling - container: divide-y divide-gray-200 border rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Header: w-full flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-4 text-left font-medium text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-blue-500. Icon: ChevronDown w-5 h-5 text-gray-500 transition-transform duration-200, rotate-180 when expanded. Panel animation: CSS grid trick - grid grid-rows-[0fr] when closed, grid-rows-[1fr] when open, with transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-200. Inner content wrapper: overflow-hidden. Content: p-4 pt-0 text-gray-600. Modes: single (only one open at a time, like radio) or multiple (independent toggles). Keyboard: Enter/Space toggle, Arrow keys navigate between headers. State management: controlled (value, onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Animation: supports prefers-reduced-motion by disabling transitions. Props: type="single"|"multiple", collapsible (allow closing all in single mode), defaultValue, value, onValueChange. Item props: value (unique identifier), disabled.
